title: feat(nsxe3sz): x-axis same-lock +e_3 z-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: x-axis same-lock +e_3 seed, z-probes. Near-twin of #7191: the two differ only by the seed lock sign at (1,0,0), which is a 6-neighbour of the z-probe D, so exactly one letter (-e_3) separates the two cells and both still hold/hold. This is the band's only demonstration that a seed sign flip CAN reach a probe -- and that even then the verdict is unchanged.
